notes.title: Update 6 - Bug fixes for the new year!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768758/5aa3c6fb7b1899932ec33f1795a86a9b181658ee.png

Cyclist friends and bike fans,

A short update is available for PCM!

On behalf of the entire PCM team, we would like to take this opportunity to wish you a very happy holidays! 🎄

Changelog:

 Race (Team-Time-Trial): Fix a possible classification difference between provisional race rankings and latest results page. It is now the 4th rider on the team who determines the team’s time for TTT rankings.
 Pro Cyclist: Fixed the bug which did not reset the Pro Cyclist points at the start of the new year. In order to maintain balance, the points awarded according to Pro Cyclist’s level have been revised slightly downwards.

Available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063610/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2023/

notes.title: Update 5 coming live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768758/5aa3c6fb7b1899932ec33f1795a86a9b181658ee.png

Cyclist friends and bike fans,

A new update is available for PCM, after a week in Beta!

Changelog:

 Pro Cyclist: Fix "SuperLeader" skill's bug which did not offer the bonus for the teammate.
 AI/Race: Fix the bug where early breakaway won nearly everytime on small continental races with slighty hill relief.
 Race (Individual Time-Trial): Fix energy “exploit” during Mountain Time-Trials (same fix as on patch 3 but for ITT's).
 Race (Team-Time-Trial): Improve AI: fix riders which were often dropped and most teams exploded because of too big differences between bad and good time trialists.
 Career: Improve rider's decline: now decline happens a bit earlier than before and few riders may have a very early or very late decline.
 Career: Improve balancing for the young riders who stops their career early: no more juniors 2) Riders with low potential will tend to end their career but in a less systematic way and more dependent on their age (a low potential at 20 years old will be less likely to retire than a 25 years old rider for example).
 Career: Fix victory's counter in the rankings'page which was not reset at the start of the new year.
 Career: Fix victory's total in rider's page (Career tab), the number was sometimes not coherent.
 DB: Optimize career's sizes/palmares.
 Multiplayer : Fix Time-Trial bug (both ITT’s and TTT’s) which caused the cyclists of a missing player to race on a slow pace.

Available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063610/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2023/

notes.title: Patch 4 going live!
notes.notes:
Cyclist friends and bike fans,

A new update is available for PCM today!

PATCH NOTES 4: 

 Freshness/recovery system improvements during stage races: freshness decreases more slowly now.
 Freshness/recovery system improvements during stage races: green energy gauge get less reduction for a given freshness.
 Remove a duplicate effect of fatigue during stage races in one-off mode.
 Race Gameplay/Physio: remove an effect that caused riders to have gradual decrease in watts during their second half of their green bar.
 Clean news on “month turn” if you have more than 5000 news to avoid a possible but rare block of the game with some mods.
 Fix a 3d-race crash.
 Modders request feature: if you have a U23 team with no real main team (link = team 119/free agents), the country set for transfer policy will be the U23 team.
 Fix a bug in the AI U23 draft: Sponsor's regions were not taken in account.
 AI U23 draft: Small tuning to give a bit more importance for sponsor's regions.


WHAT'S COMING NEXT:

 Improve AI on short and easy hilly classics: early breakaways win too often
 Team Time Trials: improvements and fix problems with teams often splitting in different groups after several kilometers.


Available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2063610/Pro_Cycling_Manager_2023/

notes.title: Patch 3 is live!
notes.notes:
Cyclist friends and bike fans,

A new update is available for PCM. 

Race

 Soften physical attributes effects (Stamina, Resistance): they act a little later on the green energy bar.
 Adjust Recovery & Freshness for stage races: a bit more green energy for a given freshness, and a bit less difference between riders for recovery between two stages.
 Fix energy “exploit” during long climbs (alternation Effort cursor 95/30% to empty then fill the red energy). A low effort means now a smaller power and thus cancel exploit’s effect.


Pro Cyclist

 Objectives: races during targets give a bonus to “race-day condition”
 Objectives: fix the bug which displayed objectives for Pro Cyclist (footer and Riders page)
 Improve progression of Stamina and Resistance attributes. To make the most of these settings, you have to start a new game (on an existing game, the improvements are present but less marked).


Career

 Fixed the bug “I can't choose a trainer for U23 runners”: the component has been removed (intented behavior). There is no penalty of riders’progression from U23 teams.
 Fixed the win count bug for towers in the Archives page.
 Fixed the bug when the player had no U23 team, the other U23 teams did poor recruitment (sometimes only 3-5 riders)


Multiplayer

 Fixed a bug displaying the race name in the calendar (variable instead of the race’s name).


Various

 Addition of the “Medium Mountain” attribute in the “Start list” page
 Fixed display of sponsor objectives icon instead of rider’s objectives icon in the Calendar page.
 Update Jerseys / Database


Hotfix

 Fixed a bug that prevented proper recruitment of U23 teams when the player did not have a U23 team of his own.

notes.title: New update is coming!
notes.notes:
Cyclist friends and bike fans,

A new update is available for PCM. You can read the most important points below, or read the full changelog.

Most important points
👉Important sprint train improvements: teams organize themselves better according to their resources.
👉Fixed too easy sprints in mountain finish with AIs starting too late without properly using their energy.
👉Fixed issues with disconnection/game crashes when the server was unstable.
👉Fixed the crash in multiplayer games that happened within the rankings page during a race.
👉Fixed the shift that appears from season 2 Pro Cyclist between calendar and rider’s fitness.
👉Added functionality to create typical training weeks for Pro Cyclist blocks.

Full changelog
Race

 Important sprint train improvements: teams organize themselves better according to their resources.
 Fixed too easy sprints in mountain finish with AIs starting too late without properly using their energy.
 Sprinters start sprints a little earlier and with a little more variation.
 Fixed a bug that caused riders wanting to catch up to a leader to not apply high enough power on a climb.
 Fixed racing map interface bug in 2560x1440 resolution.
 Fixed the bug of custom comments from riders never being played.
 Team time-trial: The display of times in the team rankings was not correct and did not correspond to the sum of the individual times.


Multiplayer

 Fixed issues with disconnection/game crashes when the server was unstable.
 Fixed the crash in multiplayer games that happened within the rankings page during a race.
 Added player names (with specific color) into rankings.
 Fixed bugs that prevented the ladder from being functional.


Pro Cyclist

 Fixed the shift that appears from season 2 Pro Cyclist between calendar and rider’s fitness.
 Added functionality to create typical training weeks for Pro Cyclist blocks.
 Fixed wins in the Achievements tile.


Career

 AI Roster improvements for leaders to participate more in the Dauphiné and Tour d'Helvétie in June.
 AI Roster improvements for sprinters to participate much more often in the UAE Trophy in February.
 Fixed a bug that caused sprinters to often participate in Medium Mountain Classics (Gran Premio San Sebastian, GP di Lombardia). Fix only valid on new games AND if the mods also fix the problem on their side.
 Increase in maximum budgets for teams (1.2 M€ / month => 1.5 M€ / month).
 Various fixes for visual issues or component overruns.


Other/Various

 Fixed a possible crash when a player loads or creates a game.
 Small corrections on various stages (Vuelta, Switzerland, Catalonia).
 Update New Music.

notes.title: First update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We just pushed the first fixes for Pro Cycling Manager 2023:

* Fix a possible crash during race's loading
* Fix Crash in the calendar page when you added or removed a race and your U23 team was registered
* Fix the bug of the train of sprint with your sprinter who gets drop when the pilot launch his sprint
* Improve Top GC leaders choice of goals (more chances to target Tour de France)
* Improve Young riders progressions (<23 years old)
* Fix the bug of the DB'size
* Fix: Selecting "Climber" as second axis does not give the proper bonus in the training specialisations
* Add missing locs for 🇵🇹 🇪🇸 🇩🇰 🇳🇴 🇳🇱 🇩🇪 🇮🇹 (was 🇬🇧 before)
